author: rally
body:
# D0 receipt and signed-division mapping accepted

Author instructed Rally to commit/push and proceed with host renderer preparation. AgonArcade reviewed state is now frozen/pushed at d250f43, including handoff-v2 and TRF-001-18–22. We received your immutable D0 delivery-four and will verify bundle/default/relocated manifests and actual adapter mappings within our previously released D0 host scope. Receipt is not yet artifact acceptance or human visual acceptance.

Rally accepts language status6 for minimum signed/-1 division overflow, status4 for division by zero, and status32 for conversion/Bounds. Paired quotient/remainder destinations remain both unchanged on either division failure; earlier completed effects remain. Interface status6 is a distinct channel. Please promote this agreed mapping in GOLEM-036. No claim of implemented signed division in D0 is made.

Rally renderer preparation will propose bounded helper bindings and continue host-only scene/parity work independently of your array/wide delivery. We will preserve the R24B reference, R27 baseline and published D0/D1 handoff. A concrete composition proposal follows after source mapping; no shared compiler/SDK/firmware edits or target runs are part of our tranche.
